integrity: Self-review of the stated theorem; independent validation and publication-status claims are not made. Historical bibliography includes incompletely accessible early full texts; no human originality guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Exact for linear binary words with known length and presence-only contiguous length-three factors; no claims for cyclic, noisy, multiplicity-aware, other-factor-length, or larger alphabets. The finite segment is exhaustively certified by a complete recurrence, and the infinite segment by a symbolic disjoint-block bound.
title: The sharp full-support threshold for binary three-factor spectra
